name: atom-grid
title: Atom Grid
description: Dot-matrix loading indicator: a small grid of dots lit in a moving pattern, pure CSS with no JavaScript once rendered. Orbit, orbit-duo, diamond, vortex, spiral, ripple, pulse, snake, scan, wave, diagonal, rain, cross, saltire, corners, checker, sparkle and heart patterns; any grid size, dot size, gap and speed; circle, rounded, square or diamond dots with an optional glow.
